method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: If the Company determines, in its sole discretion, at any time (including in respect of past trades, payouts, or account activity), that the Customer has engaged in, attempted to engage in, benefited from, or is suspected of Prohibited Trading, the Company may take proportionate enforcement action without prior notice, explanation, or evidence; payout is also not due if trading is judged inconsistent with the intended commercial purpose of the Programme.
facts.locator: Prohibited Trading enforcement; Risk Management Group (clause 8)

facts.text: Under clause 3.6 the Company may change risk parameters including drawdown parameters and allocated simulated capital, halt instruments, close positions or suspend accounts, whether or not the Customer has engaged in Prohibited Trading.
